name: TurboTax
shortDescription: Step-by-step filing. File-yourself pricing on the page runs from $0 to $139.
longDescription: TurboTax's online pricing page lists file-yourself tools from $0 to $139, with state extra, expert help from $59 to $209, and a dedicated expert starting at $129. We did not start a return.
pricingNotes: File-yourself tools are listed from $0 to $139, with state extra. A dedicated expert starts at $129.
bestFor: Filing a personal return with step-by-step software
notIdealFor: A business that wants invoice capture rather than a personal return
strength: TurboTax lists file-yourself pricing from $0 to $139, and says state filing is an additional charge.
weakness: The $0 end of that range is not the expert-file option, which the same page starts at $129.
smokeTestNotes: Official page checked on 2026-10-19. No account, payment, or hands-on run.

useCaseFit.do-taxes: Lists guided personal tax filing, with a file-yourself range that starts at $0.
